blocks.text: CITY OF NAGA, CEBU, Philippines — Modern information and communications technology (ICT) is redefining public service delivery across the Visayas, highlighted by an interactive workshop hosted by leading fiber internet and technology provider Converge ICT Solutions Inc., through its corporate and large enterprise unit, Converge Global Business Group (GBG). Brought to the City of Naga, Cebu, as part of the award-winning Elevating Connections series, ‘Elevating Connections: Reimagining Public Service — Digital Transformation’ Workshop for LGUs served as a strategic platform to address evolving civic digital needs and demonstrate how advanced ICT solutions enhance local government operations.
